messages.subject: [ACTION] iManage DMS maintenance window - Sat 21 June 20:00-23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable this Saturday 21 June between 20:00 and 23:00 for a scheduled index rebuild. Please check in any documents you are working on before 19:30. Email and the network will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
